notes.title: Shakedown Tactics Update
notes.content:
Attention, Debt Enforcers!

Our first major update has just arrived! We’re thrilled to share the "Shakedown Tactics Update" with you all!

1. New Mechanics
Take your audits to the next level with [b]Asset Declarations[/b]! Dive deep into the lives of debtors to ensure every cent of taxes is properly accounted for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642305/888f11e67676e3093d5975ca6ad2dddb87fb1794.png[/img]
Plus, we’re introducing the [b]Evidence Folder[/b], a collection of information gathered by our highly dedicated inspectors. Knowledge is power, and these tools will make debtors think twice before messing with our essential collections department!


2. Overhauled Timer System
We’ve revamped the call timer mechanics. The timer now runs continuously during calls, making time management critical as you sift through ever-growing piles of debtor information. The challenge ramps up as the game progresses—but don’t worry! This feature can be disabled anytime for a more relaxed experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642305/b0e34d92e780cef840fe555b9a1ec51190e1a0e1.png[/img]

This update was shaped by your feedback, and we’re excited to see how you’ll use these new tools in action!

notes.title: Sneak Peek: New Mechanics Coming Soon
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to give you a sneak peek of two exciting new mechanics that will be added to Debtors' Club in the next few weeks!

[b]Tax Record Check[/b]
You’ll soon be able to dive into a company’s tax records and compare them with their assets. If you find something suspicious—like an undervalued mansion or unpaid taxes—you can stamp it as “suspect” and earn a bonus (or a penalty) to your next dice roll!

[b]Evidence Folder[/b]
Keep an eye on businesses closely monitored by City Hall. Use the Evidence Folder to compare clues with the asset list, and if something doesn’t match up, mark it as “suspect” to gain an advantage in your next move!

These mechanics will add more depth to your calls and also expand your knowledge of these businesses, presenting new situations that reveal how this shady City Hall keeps its commercial partners under intense observation.

The screenshot below is a work in progress and may change in the final version, but it gives you a solid idea of what to expect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44642305/23e0c64fb3a13cb95bfe42cceacfe88c24792089.png[/img]


We’ll keep you posted as these features roll out. See you soon!

notes.title: Debtors' Club is officially out NOW!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Debtors' Club is now available on Steam! We can't wait to see how you’ll navigate the hilarious and chaotic world of debt collection.

🧾 Enforce City Debt Recovery Step into the shoes of a relentless debt collector. Use different types of persuasion to ensure the city's finances stay on track. But beware—each action could have unforeseen repercussions!

🌍 Diverse Story Paths and Endings Experience a variety of outcomes as you navigate through different narrative routes, with each playthrough offering new challenges and endings based on your choices.

🎮 Extensive Content Engage with a mix of meticulously crafted stories and dynamically generated scenarios. Each narrative path features unique mini-games, activities, and scenes, providing hours of replayable gameplay.

💰 Celebrate & Save During Launch To celebrate the game's launch, Debtors' Club is available at a 10% discount! Now's the perfect time to jump into the chaos and see if you have what it takes to be the city's top collector.

💞 How You Can Support Us As a small indie team, your support means everything to us:
Leave a review on Steam! Your feedback is invaluable and helps other players discover the game.
Share the game with friends, family, or on social media. Word of mouth goes a long way in helping indie games thrive.

Join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/Ts3Gy8R6mM]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=http://www.twitter.com/mecagamesdev]Twitter[/url] to connect with fellow collectors and stay updated!

Good luck out there, and remember: everyone must pay in the end!

mecagames
